title: Complete Telegram update trust-boundary evidence
requirements: Complete the TG-001/TG-002 evidence rather than adding new product behavior. Update the recognized Telegram Update member allowlist to match Telegram Bot API 10.3: message, edited_message, channel_post, edited_channel_post, business_connection, business_message, edited_business_message, deleted_business_messages, guest_message, message_reaction, message_reaction_count, inline_query, chosen_inline_result, callback_query, shipping_query, pre_checkout_query, purchased_paid_media, poll, poll_answer, my_chat_member, chat_member, chat_join_request, chat_boost, removed_chat_boost, managed_bot, subscription and stopped_message_generation. Message and callback_query remain the only accepted members; every other listed member is an unsupported ignore with no context.

Add direct parameterized tests for configured secret rejection including non-string, empty, disallowed ASCII, Unicode and overlength; header missing, non-string and wrong values producing identical UNAUTHORIZED code and safe message; no configured or supplied secret appearing in error str/repr or accepted/ignored result serialization; and proof that unauthorized parsing never inspects the body.

Add direct message tests for accepted update_id 0 and 2147483647, valid 4096-character text, deterministic trusted context and unknown-field spoof resistance; malformed non-mapping/missing/boolean/negative sender id or missing/non-boolean is_bot, malformed chat mapping/type/boolean id, malformed message_id and non-string/empty/whitespace/overlength text; and exact ignored reasons for bot senders, group/supergroup/channel chats and media-only messages.

Add direct callback tests for malformed empty/whitespace/non-string/overlength callback id, malformed sender forms, bot ignore, absent message inline ignore, non-mapping/malformed message, explicit non-private chat ignores, malformed private chat/message_id, non-string/empty/over-64-byte data, and acceptance at exact 64 UTF-8 bytes for both ASCII and multibyte input. Assert callback id/data preservation, immutable results and validated context.

Parameterize every Bot API 10.3 recognized unsupported member and prove unrelated spoof-only/no-member bodies remain MALFORMED_UPDATE. Use exact TelegramUpdateError codes and IgnoredTelegramUpdate reasons; do not rely on a broad happy-path test or broad Exception assertions.

Copy this exact task contract from the primary checkout .pipeline/TG-003-spec.json into tasks/specs/TG-003.json. Keep the adapter pure and side-effect free; do not add HTTP, SDK, environment loading, logging, persistence, identity/conversation calls, rendering, delivery, retry behavior or external calls.
acceptance: Every trust decision and Bot API 10.3 Update member in the adapter has direct focused evidence, including exact byte and identifier boundaries.
Only authenticated private text and accessible private callbacks can produce a validated trusted context; all malformed and ignored classes are explicit.
Focused Telegram tests, conversation regression, complete project tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Test and compatibility completion for the accepted Telegram trust boundary before functional transport integration.
